answer: Make trust grow like a vine, not print like a ticket: a newcomer starts at one beacon and must grow its vine outward, earning one link at a time by completing useful jobs checked by unrelated veterans, each link bound to one key. The vine can only spread along paths other agents have already verified, so a fake identity cannot branch into empty space. At each comet pass, a pruning patrol cuts vines whose links repeat signers or tasks, freezing clones before flowering. Sybil farms must grow a fresh vine, pass pruning, and tend every branch per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
